relationships.ikki-kurogane: Requested to meet him out of knightly admiration.

periods.summary: John calls Lunaeyes to request consultation about the suspected Rebellion criminal and also asks to meet Ikki, whose Seven Stars battles impressed him. He greets Stella, Lunaeyes, and Ikki warmly in Luxel and is shown as polite, self-effacing, and easily managed by Lunaeyes. Or-Gaule later reveals John was already under puppet control: John killed King Clef, killed or helped kill Quedland's strong knights, issued the invasion declaration, and restrains Stella while endlessly apologizing. At Caldia he appears on his Golden Chariot as the 'new king' whose declaration Lunaeyes says Vermillion will accept under League war rules.

key_events.summary: Calls Lunaeyes and invites Ikki to Quedland.
While controlled, attacks and restrains Stella and is revealed to have been forced into murder.
Appears as Quedland's new king beside Or-Gaule and Lunaeyes.
